create_MultiModalStaticCache: create a MultiModalStaticCache with a max_size limit for server-level multimodal embedding caching
build_MultimodalCache_combine_hashes: build a combined hash from a list of individual multimodal item hashes using MultimodalCache.combine_hashes
test_MultiModalStaticCache_get: test MultiModalStaticCache.get to retrieve a cached embedding result by list of multimodal hashes
refactor_MultiModalStaticCache_set: refactor MultiModalStaticCache.set to store an embedding with LRU eviction when cache exceeds max_size
review_MultiModalStaticCache_free: review MultiModalStaticCache.free to remove a cached embedding by hash and update current_size
